curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Cast out by fearful neighbors, how far can one grieving settler push back against a merciless gang on the open frontier?
curatedMovie.description: In 1870s America, a peaceful settler slays the man who killed his family, sparking the wrath of a brutal gang leader. When cowardly locals abandon him, he must take on the outlaws alone.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, gritty Western tension; steady momentum, stark frontier hostility, and sustained solo stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A tight, focused frontier Western delivering pure, suspenseful vengeance. At an economical 92 minutes, it transforms brutal isolation into a steady, gritty pursuit.
